tools.name: create_burofax_draft
tools.description: Renders supplied, user-approved letter text and postal addresses as an A4 PDF draft in Spanish or bilingual text. Both the sender and the recipient address must be in Spain; others are rejected before anything is stored. Returns the page count, the price of each delivery option and a private review
